papers.title: Selective laser melting of AlSi10Mg: Influence of post-processing on the microstructural and tensile properties development
papers.first_author_affiliation: Photon Laser Engineering, Photon AG, Staakener Str. 53–63, D-13581 Berlin, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Moataz M. Attallah
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Metallurgy and Materials, University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham B15 2TT, UK

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10Mg的选区激光熔化及后处理对拉伸性能的影响，完全未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力遮挡问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on AlSi10Mg alloy and does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究后处理对SLM成形AlSi10Mg微观组织和拉伸性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 对SLM样品进行不同热处理，表征微观结构并测试拉伸性能
summary_zh.result: 后处理显著改变了显微组织和拉伸性能，优化工艺可提高延展性
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜和拉伸试验验证微观结构和力学性能变化

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of post-processing heat treatments on the microstructure and tensile properties of AlSi10Mg fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: SLM-fabricated AlSi10Mg samples underwent various heat treatments, followed by microstructural characterization and uniaxial tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Post-processing significantly altered the microstructure and tensile properties; optimized heat treatment improved ductility while maintaining strength.
summary_en.validation: Microstructure was validated via SEM and EBSD; tensile properties were validated through standardized mechanical testing.

papers.title: Selective laser melting 3D printing of Ni-based superalloy: understanding thermodynamic mechanisms
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Nanjing 210016, China

corresponding_authors.name: Dongdong Gu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Nanjing 210016, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金的SLM热力学机制，与生物医用植入物无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structures, no mechanical testing related to implants, and no osseointegration or fatigue analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解镍基高温合金SLM过程中的热力学机理。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验和模拟分析SLM过程中的温度场和相变。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了SLM工艺参数对热力学行为的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 与实验结果进行对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the thermodynamic mechanisms during selective laser melting of Ni-based superalloy.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization and numerical simulation of temperature field and phase transformation in SLM process.
summary_en.result: Revealed the influence of process parameters on thermodynamic behavior.

papers.title: Prediction of porosity in metal-based additive manufacturing using spatial Gaussian process models
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering, Texas A&M University, College Station, TX, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Alaa Elwany
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering, Texas A&M University, College Station, TX, United States

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用空间高斯过程预测增材制造中的孔隙率，其代理建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建。
llm.why_not_core: no FEA validation, no implant biomechanics or design optimization, no constraints handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测金属增材制造中的孔隙率以控制质量
summary_zh.method: 采用空间高斯过程建立工艺参数与孔隙率之间的映射
summary_zh.result: 模型能够有效预测孔隙率分布并提供不确定性估计
summary_zh.validation: 通过增材制造实验样件验证预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To predict porosity distribution in metal additive manufacturing for quality control.
summary_en.method: A spatial Gaussian process model is developed to map process parameters to porosity.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicts porosity and provides uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation using additively manufactured specimens.
